verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents an official MCP server that exposes controls, tests, vendors, frameworks and risks as tools, including headless setups. An external AI agent can therefore operate the product through natural-language requests. Its own Comply AI features are task-specific generation tools (AI text revisions for policies, risk scoring) rather than a general natural-language command interface. Missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language command or chat interface, documented examples of end-to-end NL-driven operations, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP-based workflow.
